text: Binary: 1 if at least one other-user comment in OC_comments (JSON list, not the OP) argues that the OP's own stated premises in title/argument contradict each other or are mutually inconsistent (an internal logical contradiction in the OP's position); a comment that also cites external evidence still counts. Returns 0 for a valid list where no comment does so (including comments that only dispute premises with outside facts or merely disagree) and for a valid empty list. Returns null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if title and argument are both missing. Uses current text including marked edits; ignores OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting the outcome (generic delta/platform-rule discussion remains eligible); list order is irrelevant.
